*1.55X SELEX buffer*

*1.55x Promega Buffer, 155μM EGTA, 1.55mM DTT, 3μM ZnSO4 (no dIdC)*

250 mL

| Promega Buffer 1.55 (10X) | 38.75 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| EGTA (0.5 M) | 77.5 uL |
| DTT (1 M) | 387.5 uL |
| ZnSO4 (100 mM) | 7.5 uL |

Make up the volume to 250 mL and filter the solution. Store at 4 degrees.  
Aliquot 8.5 uL of 1.55X SELEX Buffer per well of NUNC 384-well plates

*1X SELEX buffer*

*1x Promega Buffer, 100μM EGTA, 1mM DTT, 3μM ZnSO4 (no dIdC)*

250 mL

| Promega Buffer 1 (10X) | 25 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| EGTA (0.5 M) | 50 uL |
| DTT (1 M) | 250 uL |
| ZnSO4 (100 mM) | 7.5 uL |

Make up the volume to 250 mL and filter the solution. Store at 4 degrees.

HT-SELEX Protocol Summary  
4.5 uL protein \+ 8.5 uL 1.55X SELEX Buffer  
Add 5 uL DNA to mix above. Incubate at RT, 30 mins.

Aspirate blocking buffer from Ni beads. Add 20 uL of 1 X SELEX Buffer. Transfer previous mix to the beads \+ 20 uL 1 X SELEX buffer.

Seal plates and incubate 1900 rpm, 45 mins.

Wash and then add 35 uL of elution buffer per well. Heat plates at 80 degrees, 15 minutes to elute out DNA.

*SBP Histone Octamer Plate*

Octamer concentration \= 7.25 ug/uL \= 7250 ng/uL

Number of experiments \= 9

Volume per experiment \= 1.8 uL

Volume needed per well \= 20 uL

Prepare 30 ng/uL octamer with 25 uL per well ⇒ 20 X 400 X 30 \= 240 ug SBP-octamer

Take 41 uL of original octamer and make up solution to 8000 uL (add 240 uL 100 mM TCEP \+ 7719 uL of refolding buffer:glycerol (1:1))

1000 uL per well along a column of a deep storage plate → 83 uL per well of a Greiner 96-well plate → aliquot 20 uL per well of a 4ti384 well plate (store octamer at 4 degrees)
